## Integrated student-tracker DEMO

Manual synthetic input only. Reuses the app, chapter, quiz, wellness and submitted-feedback mappers with one shared roster. Advisor duties and exam targets are explicit manual samples, not a ClickUp integration. All data tables write atomically; partial bundles stop. No live freshness success is created. Export a validated snapshot with student-tracker/snapshot.py, then refresh the dashboard. No Alcovia API or messages are sent.
